Cause: dedupe compares journal closeTime vs closeTimeBroker (two different clocks) so an out-of-order close is silently dropped. Account A halts after 1 more loss instead of 3. Second finding: pivot stop refinement (server/index.js:3902) has NO minimum distance — SPX live stop is 0.14pt (= pivots.s1) inside a 0.36pt spread; the RR>=1.5 guard can only reject too-WIDE stops.
